video.DecodeAccelVDPerf: Add H.264/VP8/VP9 1080P@30FPS VD performance test. This CL adds additional performance tests for the new video decoders based on the media::VideoDecoder interface. Tests are added for the H.264, VP8 and VP9 codecs using an 1080P 30FPS video. These tests run directly on top of the video decoders using the video_decode_accelerator_perf_tests binary. These tests are different from the video.PlaybackVDPerf tests that measure the performance of the entire Chrome video stack.
